verdict.rationale: Any public-facing website with documentation could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to the Comptroller. Direct probes found no such docs: llms.txt returned 404, the markdown docs variant returned 404, and every OpenAPI candidate path returned 404. The keyless Socrata JSON dataset on data.texas.gov is a machine-readable data rail on a host platform, not agent-oriented documentation, so it earns no credit for this story.
